suggestion: Review the converted `order.*` calls, and configure position sizing and fill economics in whatever consumes the `orders` channel.

message: `strategy(...)` was stripped to a `defineIndicator`; backtester args were dropped.

message: The explicit `array.shift`/`*.delete` FIFO eviction was removed; the ring buffer evicts implicitly.
suggestion: No action needed; the ring's modulo-K write reproduces the eviction.

message: Pine `array.sort` sorts the array in place; chartlang `array.sort` / `<slot>.sort` returns a fresh sorted COPY and never mutates the ring, so reads of the original window after the sort are unchanged.
suggestion: Capture the sorted copy (`const sorted = win.sort("desc")`) and read from it, instead of re-reading the original array.

message: A `strategy.entry`/`strategy.order` direction argument is not the literal `strategy.long` or `strategy.short`, so the side could not be resolved at conversion time; `order.buy` was assumed.
suggestion: Pass `strategy.long` / `strategy.short` directly, or split the call into the two branches your condition selects between.
